title: Deployment Manifest
description: Single declarative input that drives hands-off bootstrap (ADR 0483). An operator authors this one file; everything else — identity.yml, connection.yml, topology.yml, profile.yml — is derived from it plus the probe results.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump on incompatible changes.

slug.description: Deployment slug. Short, DNS-safe identifier. Used as the directory name under .local/deployments/ and as the apex_slug template variable.

apex_domain.description: Apex domain for this deployment (e.g. 0fork.com). Must be DNS-controlled by the operator.

operator.description: Operator identity. Appears in ACME registrations, mail headers, Proxmox notifications.

provider.description: Where the Proxmox host lives and how to reach it initially.

kind.description: Provider type. Drives provider-specific setup steps in the bootstrap chain. Only 'hetzner' is fully implemented; others are accepted for future drivers.

host.description: Public address (IPv4, IPv6, or resolvable hostname) of the Proxmox host. Used for both SSH bootstrap and API calls.

port.description: SSH port on the Proxmox host. Defaults to 22.

initial_user.description: User for the initial SSH connection (typically 'root'). Replaced by the 'ops' sudoer in step 3-init-remote.

initial_key_path.description: Path to the SSH private key for the initial connection. Relative paths resolve against .local/ssh/.

profiles.description: Service profiles to activate. Resolved via inventory/group_vars/all/service_profiles.yml. Defaults to ['core'].

extra_services.description: Additional services not included in any selected profile.

disabled_services.description: Services to hard-disable even if a profile would otherwise include them.

secrets.description: Secret source configuration. The bootstrap chain reads secrets from here rather than prompting the operator.

source.description: How to obtain secrets during bootstrap. 'operator-stdin' is the manual path; 'openbao' uses the platform's own OpenBao instance (requires step-9 to have run). 'vault' and '1password' are future drivers.

reference.description: Secret reference path (e.g. 'deployments/mycorp/secrets' for openbao, '1password://vaults/Platform/mycorp' for 1password). Required for all sources except operator-stdin.

fail_fast.description: Abort the chain on the first post-condition failure. When false, best-effort continues and records failures.

max_retries_per_step.description: How many times to retry a failed step before aborting.

step_timeout_s.description: Wall-clock timeout per step in seconds. Steps that exceed this are treated as failures.

smoke_endpoints.description: URLs to verify at final-smoke. Template variables {apex} and {apex_slug} are expanded. Each must return 200 or 308.

expected_running_vms_count.description: Minimum VM count assertion. Evaluated against qm list output at step 12. E.g. '>= 5'.

notes.description: Free-text operator notes. Not interpreted by the bootstrap chain; appears in receipts and status output.
